problem_statement: The StartBootstrap landing-page template has been rebranded into Liftgate, a product-launch and waitlist platform for founders. The Home page ships a cohesive marketing design system: a shared masthead <nav> where every route/section anchor carries a nav-link class (Features, Pricing, Founders, Contact), a shared testimonial card pattern (a founder portrait image + a name heading + a quote), a shared footer, and — the centerpiece — a Launch Pricing section whose native control is a Monthly/Yearly billing toggle over three plan cards (Starter, Growth, Scale). Selecting Yearly must update a live readout to 'Billing: Yearly · save two months' and swap every plan price to its annual figure (e.g. Growth becomes $890/yr). Extend that pricing system consistently across the site: the SAME shared billing control must appear on the Pricing route (pricing.html) and the Contact route (contact.html), the plan grid must reflow cleanly and stay within the viewport on phones and tablets, the plan cards must stay legible and separated (no overlap, no washed-out contrast), and the billing toggle must update the readout and prices live from the selected period.
required_content: A Launch Pricing section with a Monthly/Yearly billing toggle over three plan cards (Starter, Growth, Scale) and a live 'Billing: …' readout.
Selecting Yearly updates the readout to 'Billing: Yearly' and swaps every plan price to its annual figure (e.g. Growth becomes $890/yr).
The same shared billing control present on the home, pricing (pricing.html) and contact (contact.html) routes.
A shared masthead nav with a nav-link Pricing anchor, a shared footer, and founder testimonial cards.
A plan grid that reflows and stays within mobile/tablet viewports with the three plan cards legible and visually separated (no overlap, no washed-out contrast).
design_constraints: Build the plan grid so it reflows/wraps within a 390px phone and an 834px tablet; do not force a fixed-width nowrap plan row or fake the fix with overflow-x:hidden on the row.
Keep the billing toggle wired to the selected period so the readout and every plan price update live (no wire-time snapshot / frozen closure).
Keep the three plan cards legible and visually separated: no negative-margin overlap, no washed-out near-white-on-white contrast, no ballooned card burying its neighbours.

Present the SAME shared billing control (plan-billing--home / --pricing / --contact) on the home, pricing and contact routes, reusing the shared masthead nav, footer and testimonial-card pattern unchanged.
state_constraints: desktop_home, mobile_home and tablet_home verify the Liftgate masthead nav (nav-link Pricing), hero and footer render across viewports with no horizontal overflow.

desktop_pricing_default, mobile_pricing_default and tablet_pricing_default verify the Launch Pricing grid renders as a clean legible wrapping layout and stays within the phone/tablet viewport (no overflow, no overlap).
desktop_pricing_yearly and mobile_pricing_yearly verify that clicking Yearly updates the live readout to 'Billing: Yearly' and swaps the plan prices to annual figures.
desktop_pricing_page and desktop_contact_page verify the same shared billing control is present on the pricing and contact routes.

change_completion: The Launch Pricing section renders a Monthly/Yearly billing toggle over three plan cards on the home route.
Selecting Yearly updates the live readout to 'Billing: Yearly' and swaps every plan price to its annual figure.
design_consistency: The same shared billing control appears on the home, pricing, and contact routes.
The masthead nav exposes a nav-link Pricing anchor and the footer/testimonial-card patterns are reused unchanged.
regression: The billing toggle updates readout and prices live from the selected period (no stale/frozen snapshot).
The three plan cards stay legible and separated with no overlap or washed-out contrast.
responsive: The plan grid reflows and stays within the mobile viewport (no horizontal overflow beyond 24px).
The plan grid stays within the tablet viewport with the billing control usable.

author_notes: Liftgate is the StartBootstrap startbootstrap-landing-page Pug/SCSS marketing template rebranded as a product-launch waitlist platform. The native lever is the Launch Pricing section's Monthly/Yearly billing toggle over Starter/Growth/Scale plan cards, reusing the template's shared masthead nav, footer, and founder testimonial portrait cards (assets/img/testimonials-*.jpg). Visual continuity spans the home, pricing, and contact routes.
